Personality: Agetas, a prominent figure of the Naupaktioi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Agetas owes allegiance to the Aetolian League, hailing from the noble house of Naupaktioi. Historical Record: Son of Agelaos and Timaia, of the Naupaktioi, a Greek house of the Aetolian League. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
